source.manualTitle: Samsung ME11A7510DSAA Over-the-Range Microwave Service Manual

steps.title: Disconnect power and discharge HV
steps.body: Unplug the microwave or disconnect power before servicing. Discharge the high-voltage capacitor and vent run capacitor before touching HV or blower circuits. Never operate the unit with interlock switches bypassed.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Before touching any oven components or wiring, always unplug the oven and discharge the high voltage capacitor.

steps.title: Display shows C-20?
steps.body: Temp sensor error — check sensor unit and connection between sensor terminal and substrate.
steps.sourceExcerpt: C-20 Temp Sensor Error — short circuit is black wire.

steps.title: Sensor harness and connector OK?
steps.body: Inspect temp sensor unit, connector, and substrate connection. Black wire indicates short.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Inspect temp sensor unit, connector, and substrate connection. Black wire indicates short.

steps.title: Repair temp sensor harness
steps.body: Repair harness or connector and retest.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Repair harness or connector and retest.

steps.title: Replace temp sensor or PCB
steps.body: Replace temperature sensor or main PCB.
steps.oemOutcome: Replace temperature sensor or main PCB.

steps.title: Cool down and retest
steps.body: For C-21 abnormal temp — allow unit to cool and re-operate.
steps.sourceExcerpt: For C-21 abnormal temp — allow unit to cool and re-operate.
